podcast.title: Taylor Hawkins' Prog Rock Side Project (2014)
podcast.body: Formed in 2014, The Birds of Satan was a side project led by Taylor Hawkins, known for its strong progressive rock leanings. The band featured fellow Foo Fighters Dave Grohl and Pat Smear, along with keyboardist Rami Jaffee, showcasing Hawkins' diverse musical interests. "In 2014, he formed a side project called The Birds of Satan, a very prog rock band that introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song entitled The Ballad of the Birds of Satan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: The Birds of Satan (2014) - Prog Rock Side Project
xref.body: In 2014, Taylor Hawkins formed another side project called The Birds of Satan, a band with a strong prog rock sound. The group introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song titled "The Ballad of the Birds of Satan" and featured appearances from Dave Grohl, Pat Smear, and Foo Fighters keyboardist Rami Jaffee. "In 2014, he formed a side project called The Birds of Satan, a very prog rock band that introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song entitled The Ballad of the Birds of Satan."
